balls.text: dropped full toss that AB tries to swat over Bhajji at midwicket, who goes to his left, manages to get a hand to it but cannot hold on
AB gets a couple, very low full toss and he drives it past extra cover and comes back easily as long off gets around to it
fires in the yorker, outside off and it is dug out to cover
Tiwary tries the cute pick-up shot over short fine leg off a low full toss close to off, but can't get anything on the ball
AB reaches out to one full outside off, and even as he goes down on a knee, he gets it over covers, but sweeper cover gets around to it
he tries to shatter the stumps with the pacy yorker, but Tiwary manages to get some bat on it after backing away outside leg, gets the single to long off
can;t get this one away, well bowled too, full and wide outside off, he tried to reach out to stab it away  but could not get to it
another single to Tiwary, this has been a good over for Bangalore
gets a single through covers off a fuller ball
Tiwary looks as ugly as a batsman can as he goes for a swipe-pull off a short ball, gets a weak top edge that drops towards square leg
swipes a full delivery and gets it for a single to deep midwicket

whoops, AB is down, but he'll say, look where the ball is, it is in the crowd over deep square leg, it was a high full toss homing in for AB;s, he closed his eyes as he instinctively went for the hook, fell to the ground, but got so much bat on it that it went for six over deep square leg
that will be wide, tries to push it across the batsman, gets too much on the angle
lunges and gets in to some discomfort to force it off a length to long on
checks the pull and plays it along the ground off a back of a length ball, and Tiwary gets back for the second
punched hard off the back foot for a single towards long off
goes on the back foot and hits it towards extra cover for another single
gets off striker, goes on his toes to keep the short of a length ball down on the off side
Tiwary is left clueless with a short ball that cuts away outside off, he was expecting a fuller one and stabs inside the line
goes for the yorker, just a bit off target and it is swiped down to long on
full toss on the pads, but he flicks it right to deep midwicket
gets a fuller ball and drives it along the ground towards long off
tries to force it off the back foot but hits it hard in the ground
Mumbai getting in some quiet overs as the new batsmen feel their way around, driven off the front foot to Harbhajan at extra cover

superb catch from Malinga, Mumbai are clawing their way back in, it was slashed hard and was travelling to Malinga;s right at short third man before he threw himself horizontal in the air, and pouched the screamer one-handed
super ball from Munaf, has him jamming his bat down at a yorker, flies to Rayudu who gloves it over
neat front foot drive from outside off, but there is a man at sweeper cover
slants it wide down the leg side this time
punches a back of a length ball past a lunging point for a single
almost did him in with a quicker one this time, it was short of a length, it skidded and cut in as a surprised AB played over it with the attempted pull
targets the blockhole, but gets it full on to the pads, he tickles it around the corner to short fine leg

Virat is gone! Nechim had rolled his fingers on the ball, and it cut in slowly from short of a length, Virat was already swinging for the pull, and got a huge inside edge on to the stumps, can Mumbai pull things back?
slower one outside off, he had set himself up for the cut through point, it came off slowly at 114 kph and he adjusted to stab it in front of covers
fuller one and again driven along the ground, this time to sweeper cover
low full toss eased calmly down the ground to long on

he is gone! it seemed to be another of those monster sixes off a full ball, but in the end he got more height on it than anything else, Franklin kept running to his left at long on, while everyone else was resigned to the possibility of it being six more, he got around to it in the end and took the ball inches from the rope
very high full toss, Virat puts weight on back foot to pull it down to long on, handled well in the end
digs out a very full ball wide of extra cover for a single
eases it off the front foot to sweeper cover for a single
Virat gets the single down to long on
steered to short third man from outside off stump
goes hard again, but this time, Harbhajan gets it much fuller, and Gayle hits it hard in to the ground
another one, flatter but again short, Harbhajan is just not hitting the right length, Gayle goes finer this time, pulling it flat over deep midwicket
whew, the hammering continues, it was short and came off so slowly that Gayle had all the time available to rock back, ponder what to do and then pull it over deep midwicket, see ya 'gain
goes on the back foot to work one turning on leg stump to short fine leg
more damage, Mumbai continue to leak runs, full toss and Gayle shuffles and explodes in to a huge swing of the arms to send it soaring over long off
eases in to the cover drive off the front foot and gets it past extra cover
pushed away towards point this time, Virat has enough time to play himself in
creamed, the low full toss flies down the track and crashes in to the stumps at the non-striker;s
digs it short and wide down the leg side
if he had hit that one, that would have been it for that ball, Gayle went back on one leg and tried to wallop it over the bowler;s head, could not connect
misfield at backward square leg, the man got across from short fine leg but the ball burst through his hands as he dived to his right, it had been nudged off the pads by Gayle
forced off the back foot down the ground to long on
lovely ball and Gayle is beaten comprehensively, draws him forward with the flight and gets it to turn just past the outside edge as he pushes at it, no luck for Mumbai as well
stays back to a flighted ball, and tucks it past square leg for a single
another shortish ball, he punches it hard off the back foot wide of long off
rocks back to cut a shortish one turning in, in front of point
gets forward to a tossed up ball and pushes with the turn towards covers
calm forward defence from Virat Kohli, gets forward, head on top of the ball, some classicism amid all the carnage
clipped off his toes through midwicket

Rohit holds on, and then slams the ball in to the ground in anger, Mayank went back and just flat-batted the shortish ball, got not much on it and it harmlessly settled in to the hands of Rohit at long on, respite for Mumbai? don't think so
banged in short, he tries to reach for it but it beyond him, too high
Gayle opens the stance and stands like a fearsome warrior outside off, but guess what, he just guides the full toss towards point, never ceases to surprise, the big man
dropped Mumbai can't do anything right today, Mayank tried to loff over long on but did not time this fuller ball too well, Rohit came in to accept the dolly from long on and clanged it

feel for the sightscreen, it is taking a fearsome pounding, Gayle gets front leg out of the way, and murders a full ball over the bowler, it is hit so hard it wobbles erratically in the air before smashing in to the sightscreen
goes back to stylishly slash a short of a length ball on the bounce to third man
has Gayle reaching out again to a wide ball outside off, he gets it away towards point
Gayle is beaten, well, well, surprises galore today, makes room outside leg and haves a go to a ball that is slanted very wide of him outside off
eased down the track, just caressed off a very fuller length, and it strikes the stumps at the non-striker;s
initially decided that he would let this short ball darted down the leg side go, then saw it getting big close to him, and tried to pull it fine but missed
lunges to the pitch of a wide one outside off to carve it past extra cover, long off gets across to it
keeps strike with a neat push for a single towards extra cover

crunch! don't bother to run, don't bother to field, Gayle was prepared for the short of a length ball, shuffles across, gets on top of it and kills it through midwicket, the men in the deep watch it crash in to the boundary, brings up his 50 as well
as if all those runs weren't enough this time Pollard floats one wide down the leg side
goes reaching out to a fuller ball and languidly eases it in the air over covers
goes shorter to Gayle, it is getting big on him, and he works it off one leg through square leg
almost got it past short third man, shortish outside off and he opened the face to guide it but Malinga palmed it away with a dive
gentle short of a length ball that Gayle tucks away towards Malinga backward of square leg, Gayle is some way out of his ground but Lasith does not throw, hmm
on the pads, happily flicked away past Lasith at short fine leg, he does a lot of work chasing it before he manages to pull it back in
tucked away off the pads in front of square leg
almost one more, he creamed this one, it was flatter but he still smoked it off the middle of the bat, long off got around to this one though
more runs, maximum this time, comes down the track and this time he gets the loft absolutely straight and flat down the ground, just over the ropes

Mayank is playing a neat knock here, skips down the track, gets too close to the pitch but still manages to get it wide enough of long on, Pollard puts in the big dive but the ball rolls in to the boundary
fuller ball but he chooses to go back and hurriedly gets it off his pads towards square leg
full delivery outside off and Mayank drives it along the ground to long off
well bowled Munaf, the near-yorker on middle, Gayle is shuffling across and had to get bat in between his legs to dig it out, got in to a huge tangle but no harm done
got away this time, walks out to take it on the full but eases it straight to point

smoked! Munaf tries to go wider outside off with the fuller line, Gayle is waiting, out goes the front foot, a bit out of the way of the huge swing of the bat, and the ball flies flat over extra cover
forces him on the back foot with a short of a length ball and Mayank guides it past point
smacked off the front foot but there is a man at long off in place
goes for the yorker, but ends up as a very low full toss, Agarwal calmly gets forward to play him out to covers, they have negotiated half of Malinga's quota
short ball at 142.3 kph, but outside off stump, Agarwal gets the head out of the line just to be safe
no, he has reined himself in again, shuffles to one on the pads and gets off strike with a nudge to square leg
three dot balls in a row, lunges out to push a slower one to covers, can Malinga get the breakthrough this over?
pushes forward to guide a length ball towards point
they can afford to do this now, not go after every ball that is, Gayle sees this slower one on his pads and adjusts to play it out on the leg side
short of a length and Mayank goes back to push it calmly to point
follows him this time with a fuller ball outside leg stump, he forces it down to long on
almost got through him, Gayle had made lots of room outside leg, Munaf targetted the blockhole, but Gayle managed to get some bat on it and the ball scooted past short fine leg
clobber! on a friendly length is Munaf, trying to angles it across Gayle, who cranks himself up for the big swipe and uncoils to swing it disdainfully in the gap between mid on and midwicket
moves away now from a length outside off, he plays away from his body but will pick up the single to third man
and right away he is on a tight line close to off stump, Agarwal tries to force him away through the off side and almost chops it on to the stumps
Gayle plays out this ball, sensibly done, no risks, goes back and calmly pushes to extra cover
dropped by Lasith at backward square leg, Mayank went for the big sweep to a fuller ball on leg stump, swung it straight to Lasith, in to his hands, and then popped out, nothing going Mumbai's way
goes on the back foot again, this one got on to him quickly, and he jams it away towards point
Bhajji pitches short after the six the previous ball, Mayank is waiting, rocks back and puts him away through point
here comes Mayank, brings up the 50 with a shimmy down the track, right to the pitch of the tossed up ball and lofting it with the turn way over long on
turning in from a length and ending around middle and leg, tucked away towards square leg
yorker goes wrong for Malinga again, ends up wide outside leg stump, Agarwal jams down the bat on it nevertheless to pick up a single to long leg
goes for the slower yorker, but it is outside off stump, just outside off stump, Gayle squeezes it wide of backward point
Gayle does not go hard at this one, gives respect to a length ball homing in for middle, goes back and plays it out to covers
more runs, Malinga strays on to the pads off a length, Gayle is waiting, thank you very much, as he gets the faint tickle to the fine leg boundary
slower one, rolls his fingers over the ball, Gayle had set himself up to again go through the off side, saw it coming slowly outside off and decided to rein himself in
very low full toss as he misses the yorker by inches, Gayle reaches out to just push it and the ball flies past covers, don't move, don't run
goes for that cut shot again, this one gets on to him even quicker and stays a bit low, he mistimes the shot to point, Gayle wants the single, Mayank does not
tossed up slowly, he waits for it to come on from a fuller length and runs it to short third man
Agarwal in to the act, goes back to a flatter and quicker one turning in, and gets enough bat on the cut to send it racing past short third man
fired wide down the leg side off a length
looks to ease a length ball down the ground but Bhajji cuts it off running to his right
no respite for Mumbai, there is no slip in place, Bhajji tosses it up and Agarwal gets the edge as he lunges forward to drive, getting the edge that runs past short third man
turning in from a length and chopped back on the bounce to the bowler

another one, Mumbai, take cover, Gayle again makes room outside leg, this is again in his slot, full and close enough to be bashed over mid on with that monstrous swing, that is the most expensive opening over in the IPL

it's all happening, Gayle was eyeing the deep midwicket boundary, but did not get the connection with enough meat to take it over the boundary, in fact it was almost a catch as Pollard came running to his right, the ball bounced close to his toes, he overran it, the ball almost trickled over the ropes before he dived to stop it from rolling over
carnage, Nechim is leaking runs, Gayle takes a step outside leg, gets under a full ball and hammers it over the sightscreen
more runs for Bangalore, this is not a good start for Mumbai, banged in really short and flies over the keeper, he had no chance
right through Sachin at mid off, Gayle had made room outside leg and thwacked a fuller one, it flew on the bounce to Sachin and went through him
no luck for the bowler, produces the outside edge as Gayle is pegged on the crease and pushes at one leaving him outside off, ball flies past slip
nicely bowled, zipping across the left-hander who is a bit tentative and has a poke at it from the crease
slanted wide down the leg side off a length with a whippy action, they get across as the keeper does not collect cleanly
full delivery, hammers it straight back to the bowler who gets a boot to it and the ball goes towards extra cover, and that will be the end of this IPL for Mumbai
shades of Sunny Sohal, backs away a mile outside leg, and brings down an angled bat down on it to get an outside edge towards third man
Mithun continues to take a pounding, length ball, he gets under it and clobbers it way over the straight boundary
that will be four, backed away again and had a big go, got bat to ball this time, just enough to take the outside edge screaming to the third man boundary
slower bouncer dug in with the angle, passes way over his blade as he backs away to have a slog
squeezed down along the ground to long on off a very full delivery
another one very full just outside leg stump, he gets an outside edge as he has a go, AB shows quick reflexes to stop it as it races to his right
another one almost in the blockhole, dug out to mid off this time
fires it in very full, he makes room to squeeze it down to long off
tries the yorker but it goes full on the pads, batsman tries to swing him behind square leg but takes it on the pads
digs it in really short, he tries to hop and reach for it outside off but cannot
off the body and in to the keeper;s gloves, Zaheer banged it in short, he went for the pull, and Zaheer thought there was bat on it even as AB took the ball, not given
makes room and cuts from close to the stumps, Gayle at backward point puts out a hand to his left casually and stops the ball
fired in full outside leg and he can't do much with it as he tries to slog it away, rolls away towards point meekly
goes for the big pull but it loops away weakly wide of deep midwicket who this time runs to his right to cut it off
full delivery squeezed away to the bowler;s left, who does well to stop it with a dive
tries to rush out and loft it over the bowler;s head but the ball turns across to take the edge of the bat and roll away towards long off
good work by deep midwicket, it was slogged in to the gap but he made a lot of ground to his left to relay the ball to long on with a dive and a scoop
slaps a dipping flat delivery down to long off
Zaheer had targetted the stumps as he saw the batsman backing away, but he reached to it and managed to keep it out, stabbing it back to the bowler
tries to walk across and go over square leg but takes it on the pads as he misses
deep midwicket is some way inside the ropes, he had no chance to get to this one, SAthish went down on a knee and slog-swept a length ball wide of that man, some shot but too late
looks to slog a length ball, but chops it in to the ground close to the wicket on the leg side
fires it in very full just outside leg stump, batsman is backing away even further outside leg and manages to squeeze it out to extra cover
walks across to scythe a length ball in front of square leg, good old slog and good old inside edge
driven hard with the turn along the ground down to long off

one more goes down, Malinga it is this time, tries to swing it with the angle over wide long on, does not time it at all, it goes high in the air and comes down swirling on Pomersbach who takes it cleanly but teeters around teasingly close to the ropes, then goes down but holds on
looks to hammer it off the back foot but can't beat the off side infield
still flatter and a touch short, he backs away and tries to force it away, almost carried back to the bowler
Sathish gets one away, comes down the track, making room outside leg, it is fired in and he gets under it to loft cleanly over long off
tries to back away and loft inside out over extra cover, but only gets it to long off along the ground
squeezes a length ball from around off stump past point, and they take three by the time sweeper cover gets around to it
gets behind the line and pushes off the back foot down towards long on
there goes Franklin, Mumbai have crumbled, Franklin had backed away outside leg, Zaheer was bang on middle stump on a length, Frankling missed the swipe and Zaheer struck timber, Mumbai have crumbled
Franklin gets one away, stays in the crease to a length ball and uses the angle to swing it over deep midwicket
short of a length again, and he cuts off the back foot to sweeper cover
from round the stumps he digs in a short of a length ball, batsman tries to pull but is beaten
tries to cut from close to off stump and gets an inside edge that beats the keeper and rolls away on the leg side
pushed back to the bowler
shortish outside off and cut away to point
Gayle fires it in and goes up for the lbw appeal, did that strike him outside the line of off stump, not given by umpire Rauf
fuller ball and flicked away in to the leg side
reaches out and cannot do anything with a tossed up ball other than push it on the off side
clips a full and flat ball off his pads through midwicket

you won't see a better catch than that, Mithun has pulled off a stunner on the long off boundary, Pollard had got one off the middle of the bat for once, and it normally heads for six when that happens, this one seemed headed that way as well, in to the Mumbai dugout, but Mithun had placed himself an inch inside the rope, and was watching the ball come down like a hawk, it came down and crossed the ropes, but Mithun's outstretched right hand was there as well, and he managed to keep that leg planted firmly an inch inside, tremendous, the dugout is stunned, Mithun has taken off
fuller outside off stump and pushed away towards covers
fuller delivery, squeezed down the ground to long off
can't do anything with this one as well, it turned away and he gets an edge towards short third man
hurries on to the stumps and only a feeble inside edge from the batsman saves him
looks to crash a flat delivery through covers off the back foot, only finds the man at extra cover
this one hurries straight on to him, he goes deep in the crease to punch past the bowler
looks to walk down the track, but this is a very flat trajectory that he is bowling, and Franklin has to be content to push it on the off side
short and flat, on the stumps, he goes back to swipe it across the line to deep midwicket
that pitched outside leg, else Franklin was gone, he had shuffled across a long away looking for the flick and missed to be struck in front
looks to drive from outside off stump but misses the flat one going across

Ambati departs now, Dan strikes again, it was tossed up, drew Rayudu forward, but curled in a long way with the angle, with the result that Rayudu ended up pushing outside the line, and then the ball straightened from around middle and leg stump to strike him in front, gone
remains in the crease and tucks it off his pads in front of square leg

and Dan has done Rohit in with the flight and even more so, with the dip, tossed it up generously, Rohit saw the opportunity to get some runs over extra cover, even as he prepared to loft, it dipped alarmingly on him, and turned past to take the outside edge of the big swing and loop weakly in the air to sweeper cover
almost yorks himself as he comes down the track, and squeezes it away to long on
almost pushed back to the bowler, uncertain whether to charge out or not, in the end it almost carried to Dan
Rohit gets too close to the pitch of the  ball as he charges out, and gets the lofted shot on the bounce to long off
fuller one fired in around leg stump, and he clips it for a run to deep midwicket
darts it way outside off, Rohit decided not to go for it thinking it would be a wide, but it turned in just inside the line
goes straight on, but it is short of a length and wide outside off, rohit stays on the back foot and reaches out to cut it past short third man
fired in full on the leg stump, he eases it through midwicket
turns in more than he expected and Rohit chops the cut in to the ground
goes back to a flat and quick one, and takes it almost from the stumps for a run towards point
tight over from Dan, Rohit can only stab a flatter one away on the off side
nudges it around the corner towards short fine leg for a single
can't get him away, pushed back to the bowler
again Rohit does not commit forward, tossed up ball and it dips on him, he gets to the pitch to drive down the ground for a single
flighted full around off stump, pushed with the turn down to long on
does not commit forward, allows it to turn away and punches it off the back foot to sweeper cover

that is huge turn, and Sachin has fallen to the left-arm spinner, again he tried to walk down the track, Syed bowled it a touch shorter and flatter around leg stump, Sachin stopped in his tracks, trying to deal with the changed trajectory, but he was in no position to negotiate the sharp turn past him that took the ball just outside off where AB was waiting, and had the bails off even as Sachin tried to get the back leg back in the crease, huge strike, Sachin was motoring along nicely without a bother
whoa, he walks down the track and turns the straight bat in his hands to send the low full toss scurrying through midwicket, comes back for the second as well
fired in down the legside, he tries sweep it fine but gets an under edge to short fine leg
darts it in from wide of the crease and he pushes it to short extra cover
drops it a touch flat and short, forced away off the back foot to long off
smack! tossed up full and he plonks front foot out, gets front leg out of the way and lofts it over the bowler's head
now he gets forward and opens the face to drive hard with the turn to sweeper cover
bowls a full toss and Sachin takes toll, makes a bit of room outside leg and generates some momentum to loft it in to the straight boundary past a diving Tiwary from long on
another one tossed up slowly through the air, and dips on him as he feels for it, reaching out a long way to flick in the air to long on
Sachin shuffles and gets outside the line to flick a fuller one through midwicket
flighted and dips on him, he comes forward and unfurls a languid push down to long off
has him reaching out to one turning away outside off, pushed in the air to extra cover
crack! Sachin gets forward to the pitch of a fuller one and drives in the air, right in the gap between mid off and extra cover
tries to help one fine as it is slanted wide down the leg side, misses by some distance
makes room looking for the neat cut through point but cannot make contact

Sachin was looking towards deep midwicket, but he will get four over short third man, wanted to pull him with the angle, but was early in to the shot and the edge swirled away over Tiwary at short third man
Rohit gets forward to caress a length ball past a diving extra cover, but mid off gets around to it
gets it to straighten a tad from short of a length, Sachin looks to punch on the up, gets a thick edge towards short third man where it goes towards Tiwary

that is the end of Harbhajan, Aravind angled in a short of a length ball from round the wicket, and Harbhajan looked to swat-pull him over deep square leg, but got it too square and the ball looped up to where deep midwicket was waiting, some yards in from the boundary
angles it across Sachin who gets front leg out to push it to covers and tries to steal a single, the throw is fired in and Sachin has to rush back
bowls it on a length around middle and leg, he calmly clips it through midwicket for a single
that has been belted, Habhajan laying in to Mithun. short of a length and wide outside off, Harbhajan gets front leg out of the way and flat-bats it over wide long off
tries to force a length ball on the up, but mistimes it to pick up a single towards extra cover
short of a length, Harbhajan with his superb timing swings it round the corner but Mayank at short fine leg saves three with a dive to his right
dispatched over wide long on, length ball close to off stump, he shuffles, gets close to the ball and wrists it over the leg side infield, bounces just inside the boundary
mid off is up and Sachin gets under a full delivery, brings down the straight bat on it and lofts it with a big followthrough, one bounce over that man and in to the ropes
shuffles across a long away, and has both feet wide apart as he keeps down a back of a length ball in front of square leg
has him ducking right away with a well-directed bouncer
that is the first one for Bangalore, Blizzard has slogged out to long on, he made room and went down on his knee to swing a fuller one hard but only got it as far as Mayank at long on
follows him with the angle from round the stumps and he gets around to force it towards extra cover,
can;t get it away, short and cutting away outside off, he reaches out but is beaten
waits for a flighted one to arrive, and even as it turns in he goes back to force it wide of mid off but can't get enough on the shot
this one is around off stump, he forced it towards Virat at mid off who fired in the throw but missed again
can;t get him away, slogs another full delivery fired in towards square leg
follows him with a yorker as he backs away outside leg, swung in to the leg side
fired in full, and close to off stump, he is surprised by the pace on that one, and AB collects
comes slowly off the track from round the stumps, he goes back to push it on the off side
goes deep in the crease to a fuller one, and opens up to slog it through midwicket, but mid on stops the ball to his right
swiped across the line wide of midwicket and the man in the deep gets to his left to field
punches on the up but not too much power on it and mid off fields
goes hard at this one but cannot get it away, Aravind gets to his right quickly to have Sachin rushing back in to his crease
another one, Sachin walks across the stumps, and picks a length ball over square leg, cheeky, and gets away comfortably with it
and Sachin threads the gap between cover and point, shifts weight on the back foot and cuts it off a length, Virat can;t get to it with a dive
bowls it a  bit fuller, and he cannot get underneath it enough, pushes on the off side
swiped away, Mumbai have begun alright till now, length ball and he swings across the line in to the gap between midwicket and mid on
almost run out, Virat gets quickly to his right at point and fires in the throw, Blizzard was in no position to get back in time, but the throw just missed
tries to drive off the front foot but mistimes it in the air towards mid off
cuts hard but Kohli at point gets hand to it, and takes a lot of pace off the ball
and right away, he goes for four, it was a full ball angled in, he used the angle nicely to swing it past mid on
